data.gov.il hosts 14 CBS datasets under the organization slug lamas, including the 2022 Population and Housing Census, the Israeli localities file, master code lists and the injury-accident public-use files.

The CBS Price Indices API base path api.cbs.gov.il/index is a path prefix, not a fetchable endpoint: requesting it directly returns the CBS error page. Only its sub-paths /catalog/catalog and /data/price return data.

The data.gov.il human browse routes under /organization/ and /dataset?organization= return an S3 AccessDenied error, in curl and in a real browser alike, while the CKAN API path still serves the data.
CBS publishes an official Linkage Calculations tool at cbs.gov.il/en/Pages/Linkage-calculations.aspx for computing an indexed amount between two dates.
